evidence_boundary: Assessment is limited to repository code, documents, reports and CI evidence available on main at audit time.

gaps.title: No general code CI enforcing the documented quality gates
evidence: The visible workflow validates roadmap documentation only.
pytest configuration disables the coverage plugin.
No demonstrated CI command for ruff, mypy, branch coverage or mutation testing.
gaps.required_action: Create a code-quality CI pipeline covering compile, full pytest suites, line/branch coverage, lint, typing, architecture checks and security checks.
gaps.gate: Required before claiming compliance with the 90 percent standard.

gaps.title: Project metadata is stale
evidence: pyproject version and description still identify Lot 10 although Lot 25 is validated.
gaps.required_action: Update metadata through a governed compatibility change without changing project identity.
gaps.gate: Required before the next release artifact.

gaps.title: Invalid numeric inputs can be converted silently to zero
evidence: Market-analysis helpers use fallback conversion to 0.0 for non-numeric values.
gaps.required_action: Replace permissive conversion at critical boundaries by explicit validation states and fail-closed reason codes.
gaps.gate: Required before data-governance closure and before any strategy label generation.

gaps.title: Thresholds and score normalizations are heuristic and uncalibrated
evidence: Trend, range, momentum, volatility and confluence engines contain fixed thresholds and manually selected denominators.
No uncertainty interval, sensitivity report or out-of-sample calibration is currently demonstrated.
gaps.required_action: Mark thresholds as provisional, move them to versioned configuration and require sensitivity, ablation, calibration and OOS evidence before alpha use.
gaps.gate: Does not block descriptive Lot 26; blocks alpha promotion.

gaps.title: No demonstrated alpha or economic rationale
evidence: Current outputs are descriptive context states and explicitly non-executable.
gaps.required_action: Introduce falsifiable alpha hypotheses, payer-of-alpha rationale, labels, baselines and retirement conditions in the dedicated research phase.

gaps.title: No implemented institutional validation stack
evidence: Walk-forward, purged CV, embargo, multiple-testing control, PBO and deflated performance metrics are planned but not implemented.
gaps.required_action: Implement the full validation stack before strategy promotion.

gaps.title: No calibrated venue-level capacity and execution-cost proof
evidence: Lot 10 provides a defensive transaction-cost foundation, not a venue-calibrated fill/impact/queue model.
gaps.required_action: Calibrate fees, spreads, slippage, market impact, queue/fill probability and capacity by venue and regime.

gaps.title: Portfolio and active risk stack are not implemented
evidence: Sizing, risk budgets, factor exposure, stressed correlation, PnL accounting and portfolio reconciliation remain roadmap capabilities.
gaps.required_action: Implement independently validated sizing, exposure, portfolio and accounting domains before sandbox/live.

gaps.title: OMS, EMS, account reconciliation and production operations are not implemented
evidence: The roadmap specifies these domains, but current implementation intentionally ends at descriptive market analysis.
gaps.required_action: Implement and fault-test OMS/EMS, idempotency, partial fills, recovery, exchange health, reconciliation, incident response and kill-switch drills.

next_gate.name: PRE_LOT26_INSTITUTIONAL_REMEDIATION_GATE
conditions: No score is labelled probability or alpha without calibration.
The code-CI and actual coverage baseline are created as a cross-cutting P0 action.
Heuristic thresholds are documented as provisional and versioned.
No paper, sandbox or live capability is unlocked.
